Thanks for flagging, Alex — hope you're ok.

Panel — short question: are we comfortable converting today's live loop to a timed written/coding exercise plus a shortened async debrief? Proposed plan:
- Send candidate a 90-minute coding prompt (no pairing) + one system-design written prompt (1–2 paragraphs) — attachments: backend_takehome.pdf
- Candidate gets 6 hours to submit (deadline 3:30 PM PST)
- Panel reviews submissions tonight / tomorrow morning; if we still want a live conversation, reschedule for Mon/Tue next week.

If Markus/Karthik confirm, I'll send the take-home and rubric. If anyone needs the live loop held, let me know now; otherwise I'll proceed.

Marissa

Alex — thanks again for letting us know and for offering the written option. Confirming plan:

1) Attached: backend_takehome.pdf (90m coding prompt) and evaluation_rubric.xlsx (internal—panel will use for scoring).
2) Deadline: 6 hours from now — 9:48 PM PST. If you need more time because of recovery, let us know; we can extend to 24 hours.
3) Submit code as a single zipped repo or a text file (candidate_response.txt placeholder attached). Please include brief notes for the design prompt (1–2 paragraphs).
4) Panel will review submissions tonight; if we want a live discussion we'll aim for Monday/Tuesday next week. We'll update you after review.

Attachments: backend_takehome.pdf (PDF, 2 pages); evaluation_rubric.xlsx (XLSX, panel scoring); candidate_response.txt (plaintext placeholder)

Thanks and speedy recovery,
